Hadith.4226 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Marid, who said:
"I heard Abu Abdullah (as), say: 'There is no believer who has a milking goat in his house except that the people of that house are sanctified and blessed.

If there are two goats, they are sanctified twice each day.'
A man from our companions then asked: 'How are they sanctified?'
Imam (as) replied: 'It is said to them: Blessed are you, and may your food be pure and wholesome.'
I said: 'What is the meaning of being sanctified?'
Imam (as) said: 'It means you are purified.'"
